scope: Source records for the 362 additions needed to cover the named community N3 set. The existing 2026-10-08 dictionaries and Unicode data were reused, not downloaded anew. This is not an official JLPT syllabus or a linguistic review verdict.

kanjidic2.transform: Japanese ja_on/ja_kun readings only, excluding nanori; primary stroke count; school grade; classical radical number. Legacy four-level JLPT values are not reused as modern levels.

jmdict.transform: Exact spelling/reading pairs honor re_restr and re_nokanji; applicable senses honor stagk and stagr. Dictionary inclusion and priority flags do not establish JLPT vocabulary membership or example-sentence naturalness.

radicalGlyphs.transform: Radical number n maps to U+2F00 + n - 1; its Unicode compatibility decomposition supplies the canonical glyph. Positional variants and Japanese simplified shapes are not inferred from this mapping.

strokes.transform: Repository tools/generate_strokes.py converter, with 16 arc-length-resampled points per stroke in the source 109 by 109 coordinate space and original stroke order. The optional tools/order_variants.json overlay was empty.

limits: The source URLs for dictionaries are refreshed upstream; hashes identify the inspected downloads. These records establish metadata provenance, not kanji etymology, phonetic roles, semantic interchangeability, or naturalness of every example. Primary words are learning examples, not a claimed N3 vocabulary syllabus. The word index records a non-exhaustive selection of primary teaching senses as entry-id:sense-index pairs (one-based within the inspected JMdict entry). Individual pages may explain and cite additional applicable senses; the index is not a complete inventory of those explanations. Other matching senses are not automatically claims of the article. 'new' and 'existing' are relative to baselineCommit.
